description: Exchange rates: the closing rate for a currency pair on a date, or a series over a range. Use when the user asks for an exchange rate, FX, a currency conversion, what the euro to dirham or pound to dollar rate is, what a currency move cost us, or whether it is cheaper to buy in one currency or another. With one date it returns that day's closing rate. With a range of 62 days or less it returns the daily closing series and the percentage change. Over 62 days it returns monthly averages (up to 36 months). Read-only, needs no company data. Quote rates from the result only.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

date.description: A single date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today when no range is given.

end_date.description: End of a range (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with start_date.

from.description: Currency to convert from, three-letter code, for example EUR.

start_date.description: Start of a range (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with end_date.

to.description: Currency to convert to, three-letter code, for example AED.

name: get_fx_rates
title: Get Fx Rates
